decisions.reason: A has already been backed publicly with a quantified customer savings claim and sits squarely in the firm's modular recycling direction, so management is very likely to continue justifying and extending the investment.

B is a close extension of the established mobile machinery range and still easy to defend as a worthwhile launch while management attributes any slower traction to normal market development rather than product failure.
As a flagship multi-model line tied to the firm's stated future direction, C carries the strongest strategic and public commitment and is therefore the least likely to be withdrawn.
E is a newly launched multi-model shredder line close to the core offer, so recent development spending and visible market introduction make management inclined to persist with it.

F is also a newly launched multi-model line with dedicated presentation and clear fit to the processing portfolio, but being somewhat less central than the flagship modular lines leaves a modestly higher withdrawal risk.
